suggestion: Add an official depth-chart source and store the starter and backup order per position

options: A) Pull NFL.com depth charts manually each week; B) Use a licensed feed; C) Defer

suggestion: Collect official schedule, scores and box scores for past seasons
benefit_for_decisions: Creates the history needed for any validation gate

main_risk: Licensing cost and legal use from Japan
options: A) Licensed paid API; B) Public free source (verify terms first); C) No odds (analysis only)

suggestion: Save a timestamped snapshot each time the injury report changes
benefit_for_decisions: Allows tracking of status changes across the week
options: A) Manual snapshots; B) Scheduled snapshots three times per game week

main_risk: Thresholds may be too strict or too loose
